pages.text: “Resilient fibers, nourishing the body and mind—providing protection for travelers.”$(br2)Flax Tea is a rich, nutty-flavored drink made from dried flax seeds and sugar. The light brown tea has a smooth taste and grants an Absorption effect upon consumption, offering extra protection for travelers.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Flax Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried flax seeds with sugar.$(br)It is ideal for drinking before battles or in dangerous environments to enhance survival capabilities.

Upon drinking Flax Tea, travelers receive an Absorption effect, providing additional protection against incoming damage.$(br)This is a beneficial tea for pre-battle preparation.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
